user.title: KakaoTalk Notifier
user.description: Enter the settings of your Kakao app. After saving, run the **kakao_talk.login** action (Developer tools > Actions) to log in to Kakao.

data_description.api_key: The REST API key of your Kakao app.
data_description.client_secret: Needed when Client secret is on in the Kakao console.
data_description.redirect_uri: Local address of Home Assistant, without a path.
data_description.link_url: Address a tap opens. Its domain must be registered at Kakao.
data_description.invite_redirect_uri: Public https:// address for friends away from home. Optional.
data_description.link_to_image: Tapping an image opens it. Its domain must be registered at Kakao.
data_description.button_title: Label of the button in a message.
data_description.send_to_friends: Also message your Kakao friends. Log in again after turning on.
data_description.friend_entities: Pick friends by name in the form. Names are visible to all users.
data_description.friends: Nicknames or IDs. Empty means every friend Kakao returns.

error.invalid_url: Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://.
error.https_required: The public address must start with https://, because it is used over the internet.

abort.single_instance_allowed: KakaoTalk Notifier is already set up.
abort.already_configured: KakaoTalk Notifier is already set up in the UI. The configuration.yaml settings were ignored.
abort.invalid_import: The kakao_talk settings in configuration.yaml are invalid, so they were not imported. Set it up from the UI instead.

init.description: Saving reloads the integration. Run **kakao_talk.login** again after changing the API key, client secret or turning on friends.

yaml_deprecated.title: KakaoTalk configuration.yaml settings are deprecated
yaml_deprecated.description: Your KakaoTalk Notifier settings were imported into **Settings > Devices & services**, which is now the only place they are used. Please remove the `kakao_talk:` block, and the `- platform: kakao_talk` entry under `notify:`, from `configuration.yaml`, then restart. Manual YAML configuration is deprecated and will be removed in a future release. The `notify.kakao_talk` action keeps working without it.
